newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS HAS BIG HOPES FOR RUSSIA.
newsitem.headline: UHIS HAS BIG HOPES FOR RUSSIA.

text.p: Uhispank said on Tuesday that it hopes its Russian leasing subsidiary will grow substantially bigger than its Estonian leasing operation.

"Uhisliising has a leasing portfolio of 500 million kroons in Estonia, which has 1.5 million inhabitants. This is compared to eight million inhabitants in the St Petersburg region," Ain Hanschmidt, Uhispank chairman, told Reuters.
He earlier signed the documents that formally brought the company into existence.
Uhispank has a 75 percent stake in the new company while the minority shares are held by Russian Neva-Rus.
Hanschmidt said the Russian leasing subsidiary, Venemaa Uhisliising (Russian Uhis Leasing), will grow bigger than the local leasing firm but could give no detailed estimates.
"Local know-how helps us to start quicker there than we did in the Estonian market," board member Ott Karolin said.
He said that Uhispank will start with classical leasing services in Russia.
"If the market was more transparent, we would start with factoring," he added.
The managing director of the new firm, Andrei Haponen, said there are only 30 leasing companies in Russia and two in St Petersburg.
The firm, due to start activities in a couple of months, will have 10 employees at the start, Haponen said.
Uhispank also plans to open leasing subsidiaries in other Baltic countries.
"Although we do not have any concrete contacts in Latvia and Lithuania, we are interested in them," Karolin said.
